name: Wrapped iTRY
oneLiner: wiTRY is a Brix staking wrapper that accrues yield over iTRY, with exposure to Turkish-lira money-market funds and local TRY instruments.
collateral: iTRY deposited into the Brix staking wrapper, backed by regulated Turkish-lira money-market funds and related TRY cash/liquidity instruments
pegMechanism: wiTRY appreciates against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract and vests over time; users can unstake through a cooldown or use Fast Redeem for a fee, while final TRY exposure inherits iTRY issuer and local-currency risk

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: wiTRY wrapper owner and iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3/5, same 5 signers) confirming issuer-controlled architecture. MegaETH OFT adapter (0x15b271d9012b5820fc42b1c495b4c1e206547de5) owner could not be confirmed — MegaETH public RPCs returned errors — but the Ethereum primary chain is fully verified. MegaETH is a bridged deployment; the Ethereum Safe controls the canonical supply. Accountable independently reconciles the iTRY and wiTRY liabilities to backing assets. The public proof-of-solvency page advertises a 15-minute interval but showed reserve data last updated 2026-06-24, so the observed evidence supports periodic, not continuous, reconciliation. No registry evidence established prudential reserve supervision over wiTRY issuance.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: wiTRY uses LayerZero OFT Adapter infrastructure between Ethereum and MegaETH. Brix docs list an Ethereum wiTRY OFT Adapter and a MegaETH wiTRY OFT representation bridged through LayerZero messaging, so the route is external lock/mint rather than MegaETH canonical rollup bridging. 2026-07-20 cohort dc-1 pass: Ethereum row confirmed native wiTRY; MegaETH row confirmed Brix multichain deployment (uniform owner read).
